About Dipole Group
We are a wholly Australian owned and operated ICT and Telecom networks specialist delivery business. Dipole operates locally, regionally, and internationally. Our capabilities span across Telecommunications, Finance, Insurance, health, Public Services, Print / Digital Media, Broadcast and Supply Chain. Dipole Group is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The Role
We are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer with strong experience to join our growing team and contribute to the development that empowers our organization to deliver exceptional customer experiences. Apply your expertise, technical acumen, and leadership skills to drive innovation and make a significant impact on our business growth.

Key Responsibilities Include:
Design and maintain Automation framework and scripts
Maintain and enhance test automation frameworks using programming languages (Java/Python/JavaScript).
Responsible for creation and implementation of test strategy, test plans, test data for testing.
Conducting and scheduling regression testing using CI/CD pipelines and documenting the results.
Reviewing requirements with Business Analysts and Technical leads
Involve with business and development teams to understand the requirements.
Review design documents for new features and participate in design reviews with the development team.
Involve in Client Engagements to understand the testing scope of the product and release
Preparing Test data by clearly analysing the requirements
Involve in Sprint Backlog refinements / grooming and planning sessions
Developing scenarios and executing automation scripts using automation framework
Implementing and maintaining regression test suite which saves the time for regression testing
Conducting demos to the stakeholders after completing the user stories
Preparation of Test Completion Report, Defect Analysis Report and share with stakeholders

Candidate Qualification:
5 years of experience in software testing as Automation and Functional tester.
Expertise in designing test scripts using Selenium Maven TestNG , Playwright, Cucumber and Rest Assured framework.
Experience in developing test plans, test cases, test data and test reports.
Experience in functional testing, User Acceptance Testing, Integration Testing, Regression Testing, UI Automation Testing using Java-selenium and Web service Automation using Cucumber and TestNG framework
Extensive experience in SDLC and Agile Process
Designing test cases and test scenarios, conducted functional, ad-hoc and exploratory testing for the variety of applications with expanded test coverage
Experience in working with GitHub as source code management tools
Experience in Bug tracking Tools like JIRA
Effective time management skills – prioritization of tasks and own time by regular follow- up meetings
Ability to remain highly focused and self-motivated in a fast-paced, demand environment.
Critical thinking and analytical skills
Good communication and teamwork skills

Next Steps
If you would like to express interest in the role, please click on the APPLY button now. Due to the high number of applicants, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further discussion within 3-5 business days. We thank you for taking an interest in this opportunity with us.

Job Description
Position Overview:
AI Talent, a pioneer in AI-powered solutions, is looking for a meticulous and experienced Software Tester to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for verifying the quality and performance of our AI applications by creating and executing test plans, identifying defects, and working closely with developers to ensure prompt resolution.
The ideal candidate will bring a solid grasp of software testing methodologies, sharp analytical skills, and a strong commitment to delivering high-quality AI software. Experience with test automation tools is a plus.
Responsibilities:
Collaborate with the development team and project stakeholders to understand software requirements and design comprehensive test plans and test cases for AI software applications.
Perform functional, integration, system, and regression testing to validate the performance, accuracy, and reliability of AI software products.
Identify and document software defects, including clear and detailed reproduction steps, in a bug tracking system. Collaborate with the development team to ensure timely resolution of issues.

Build the software that protects our most security-conscious organisations.

Most software developers improve products. Here, you'll help redefine them. At Janusnet, our software protects some of Australia's most security-conscious organisations across government, defence and critical infrastructure.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for an experienced Senior C++ / COM Developer to modernise existing products, help shape our next generation of security solutions, and bring entirely new products to market.

If you're looking for a role where your ideas influence product direction not just sprint tickets this is it.

The Perks

    Hybrid working (50/50 between home and our North Sydney office)
    Build new cybersecurity products from the ground up
    Variety across architecture, product development, innovation and emerging technologies
    Job stability and growth 

What You'll Be Doing
You'll play a key role in modernising our existing suite of trusted security solutions while designing and developing new products that respond to evolving customer needs and emerging technologies.

Working across the full software development lifecycle, you'll build secure, high-quality Windows applications using C++ and COM, applying Secure by Design principles to solutions relied upon by government, defence and critical infrastructure organisations.

Along the way, you'll collaborate with talented engineers and cross-functional teams, influence technical direction and product strategy, and contribute to a culture of innovation as we continue to expand and bring new ideas to market.

What We're Looking For:

    Extensive commercial C++ development experience
    Strong Microsoft COM and Windows development
    Experience across the full software development lifecycle Experience building commercial software productsSecure software development experience
    Experience with server and endpoint security products, security frameworks like Secure by Design, NIST or compliance standards DISP or ISM will put you well ahead.

Australian Citizenship is essential, along with the ability to obtain a Baseline Security Clearance.

Why Janusnet?

For more than 20 years, Janusnet has been developing trusted information security solutions used by government, defence and commercial organisations across Australia and around the world.

We're big enough to work on complex, meaningful security challenges, but still small enough that every engineer has genuine influence over the products we build.

Here, you'll have the opportunity to challenge ideas, innovate, and help shape technology that protects organisations where security matters most.

If you're ready to build software that genuinely makes a difference, and want the opportunity to influence products from concept through to release we'd love to hear from you!

For a confidential discussion, connect with Victoria Williams on 03 9691 4712.

Ready chart a new course?

To download the PD, and to apply for this job go to: https://janusnet.recruitmenthub.com.au/Vacancies
